title: videos result record (v1)
description: One logical videos search result as one JSONL result record: the original zero-based position in the upstream results array, the constant videos bucket, and the usable textual members the upstream result carried, including the freshness age. Absent members are omitted, never emitted as null.

age.$comment: The freshness member the videos endpoint attaches to a result, whatever textual form it carried.
